tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no build-specific exemption. This sits alongside the recorded rule to use HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no build-specific exemption. It also notes the recorded rule to use HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.

The verification decision comes from the recorded "verification on all builds" statement (#25). That statement withdrew an earlier decision (#23), so I left the earlier one out. The HTTPS decision (#28) is recorded too, but it is about plaintext rather than certificate verification, so I only mentioned it as context.
